Synthetic QCDT v1 header and two 20-byte records, packed independently with Python struct according to the verified layout in formats/qcdt.py. Payloads are the original dtc-produced overlay0.dtbo and overlay1.dtbo from tests/fixture_sources/dtbo; expected hashes come from those inputs before wrapping. The QCDT wrapper was not produced by Qualcomm dtbtool. No vendor firmware bytes are used.
